entry.title: कबीर साहब
entry.summary: जीवन में हमेशा कबीर के समीप रह कर भी मैं उनके बहुत क़रीब नहीं जा सका। जिस स्तर की जीवन की समझ कबीर साहब ने हमसे साझा की है, ऐसा भारतीय क्या समूचे विश्व के साहित्य में सायद ही किसी ने किया होगा अंग्रेजी में हम कहते है 'living example' और उसका अर्थ पूरी तरह से कबीर साहब का जीवन है, जितना बोला जय उतना ही कम है मैं आने वाले समय में अपनी सीमित समझ को और साझा करना चाहूँगा अभी की लिए कबीर को भजे और 600 साल पहले दी गई उनके सीख को जीवन में उतरे

entry.title: relationship with the ghost
entry.summary: If we observe our closest relationships, we will find, we make of them what we want, we look at parts we have interest in. It is almost like a toy in a child's hand, they do what you want to with it, fly the car or break it open, without attempting to understand the toy's true nature.

entry.title: on knowing more
entry.summary: There is a notion we all carry in society, which is the more you know, in life, in any subject, the better you are - not just an academic, but perhaps also a better human being. In fact, it is often shared as a gospel truth to younger people.

entry.title: ego and action
entry.summary: Our Ego fights action with smart questions and doubts, and if you engage in those, you fell into the trap, it’s an endless cycle from others — more questions, doubts — right and wrong, and no progress.

entry.title: overthinking
entry.summary: Overthinking is a learned behaviour from childhood that once made us feel safe, we learnt only if we computed all combinations, and considered all possibilities, we'll then find a solution to be safe – the problem is, most of us still carry this wounded part with us today, which drains our energy because things look bigger than they are, and everything feels overwhelming, so we either quit before we start or lose motivation.
